offers: Enrollment, demographics, staffing FTE, MCAS and per-pupil expenditure by function, per district, per year. The same measures as the RADAR workbook behind `dese_measure`, for all 421 districts rather than seven; checked value for value and they agree exactly. Percentages are printed here as 57.0 where the workbook stores 0.57.
